title: Autopercepción en Reflejo de Charco: Metáfora Visual de Fortaleza Interior
prompt: A small, reddish-brown poodle with curly fur and expressive dark eyes is standing on a quiet street, looking into a puddle. In the water's reflection, he sees a proud, majestic lion with a flowing mane. The reflection is realistically distorted by soft ripples in the puddle, giving the scene a dreamlike, metaphorical quality. The lighting is soft and natural, with a hint of golden hour. The image captures the contrast between the dog's small size and his inner strength, courage, and determination. --ar 1:1
